title: What If You Had to Plug In Your Brain? It Runs on 20 Watts

scenes.text: What if your brain needed a power cord? It would barely need one.
Your brain runs on about 20 watts, like a dim light bulb, even when you lie still in the dark.
It is only 2 percent of your body's mass, yet it burns about 20 percent of your energy.
That is roughly 340 calories out of a 2,700 calorie day.
A NIST scientist estimates the brain does the work of an exaflop on those same 20 watts.
The Frontier supercomputer does exaflop work too, but it needs about 20 megawatts. A million times more power.
